title: Your Name as a Heading
prompt:
The page below has an empty body. Add exactly one `h1` containing your name (use `Ada Lovelace` if you prefer not to share it), and one `p` underneath that starts with the words `I am learning`.

Rules:
- Exactly one `h1`.
- The `h1` is not empty.
- One `p` that starts with `I am learning`.

tests.name: exactly one heading
tests.hint: One page, one <h1>. Add it inside the <body>.

tests.name: heading is not empty
tests.hint:
Write your name (or Ada Lovelace) between

and

.

tests.name: an intro paragraph follows
tests.hint:
Under the heading:

I am learning web development.
